whitepaper.title: ZkVanguard Whitepaper
whitepaper.subtitle: An AI-Managed Crypto Vault That Rides Polymarket Alpha — ZK-Attested, Autonomous, Live on Sui Mainnet

abstract.highlight: ZkVanguard turns Polymarket alpha into a one-click crypto vault. Seven autonomous AI agents fuse prediction-market signals with funding rates and price momentum, allocate USDC across BTC / ETH / SUI / CRO, auto-hedge on BlueFin perpetuals, and ZK-attest every meaningful decision on-chain. The same ZK primitive powers two premium products: private hedges and a private portfolio creator. What used to require bots, capital, and 24/7 attention is now a single deposit.
abstract.p1: The platform orchestrates seven specialized AI agents—Lead, Risk, Hedging, Settlement, Reporting, Price Monitor, and Sui Pool—that autonomously read prediction-market signals from Polymarket and Manifold, blend them with BlueFin funding-rate data and Crypto.com price momentum, generate consensus allocations through a 2-of-3 voting threshold on trades above $100K, and execute swaps via the BlueFin aggregator on Sui mainnet. Each meaningful trade decision is committed to the chain through a ZK-STARK proof system (NIST P-521, no trusted setup, CUDA-accelerated when available), giving users verifiable autonomy instead of a black-box model.
abstract.p2: Polymarket alone now processes $20B+ in monthly volume, and the broader prediction-market sector grew to $63.5B in 2025. The signal is real, but riding it consistently has required custom bots, sophisticated risk management, and constant attention. ZkVanguard collapses that workflow into a one-click USDC deposit, with two revenue layers running today: on-chain protocol fees on every vault deposit (50 bps annual management plus 10% performance, routed to a multisig-controlled FeeManagerCap) and tiered subscription access to premium features (private hedges and the private portfolio creator). The same ZK rails that secure consumer flow are what unlock confidential institutional use cases as the platform scales.

introduction.opportunityText: Polymarket processed over $20B in monthly trading volume by early 2026, and the broader prediction-market sector grew to $63.5B in 2025 (CertiK). That signal is real — but three barriers keep retail users from harvesting it:
introduction.barrier1: Riding prediction-market alpha consistently requires custom bots, monitoring infrastructure, and 24/7 attention — table stakes for hedge funds, impossible for retail
introduction.barrier2: Spot signals don't size positions, set stops, or hedge — retail traders who try get liquidated or shaken out, never capturing the edge they bet on
introduction.barrier3: Every AI-agent crypto product ships an unverifiable black box — users are asked to trust a team's claim that the model works, with no on-chain proof
introduction.timing1: Polymarket scaled from speculative niche to $20B+/month volume in under three years — the signal is liquid enough to ride at retail size
introduction.timing2: ZK-STARK proofs now achieve practical performance (sub-second verification) with post-quantum security — making verifiable AI agents actually shippable
introduction.timing3: Bittensor, ASI Alliance, Fetch, and MyShell crossed $1B+ market caps; consumer expectation for AI-managed financial workflows is no longer experimental
introduction.timing4: Smart accounts, sponsored gas, one-click deposits and mobile-first wallets finally make on-chain DeFi usable for non-traders

conclusion.title: Conclusion
conclusion.text: ZkVanguard turns prediction-market alpha into a one-click crypto vault — and uses the same ZK-attested rails to power private hedges and a private portfolio creator. By combining seven autonomous AI agents, a real-time signal pipeline, BlueFin perp execution, and on-chain ZK proofs on Sui mainnet, we collapse the three barriers that keep retail users from harvesting Polymarket-grade alpha — operational complexity, missing risk management, and unverifiable AI — while keeping protocol fees plus tiered subscription revenue as the dual economic engine.
conclusion.p1: ZkVanguard combines multi-agent AI orchestration, prediction-market intelligence, ZK-STARK privacy, and gasless execution to make institutional-grade risk management accessible and private.
conclusion.p2: The stack is live on SUI Mainnet with a real capital pool, cron-driven autonomy, and eight defense gates protecting against drawdown, phantom fills, and stale hedges.
conclusion.p3: This whitepaper describes the system as it runs today, not a roadmap for the future.
